messages:
Maria K.: heads up — noticed judge-A drops preference for model-X after q8 quant run. Cohen's kappa down to 0.42 on convo evals. Anyone else see this?
Shiv P.: yup, saw the nightly. runner reported transient OOMs then fell back to fp16 for some shards. suspect cache + quant mismatch.
EvalRunnerBot: CI job #9876 failed: judge-sample-runner timeout at 1765429001. Logs: "timeout waiting for response from judge-A".
Eli G.: one idea: introduce a socratic tiebreak heuristic for close disagreements. if judges disagree and confidence gap < 0.12, have the judge ask a single clarifying question before final verdict. keeps the decision grounded instead of arbitrary tie-break.
Ash S.: cautious — adding followups can shift style preferences and introduce bias. we should run demographic parity checks before enabling across traffic.
Maria K.: agreed. high level plan: 1) surface judge confidences in the runner, 2) add weighted aggregation fallback, 3) socratic followup as last resort, 4) run stratified parity tests.
Shiv P.: quick patch to runner: include_confidence flag isn't surfaced today. current call: client.request(judge, payload) -> returns {winner}. change to client.request(..., include_confidence=True) -> returns {winner, confidences}. tiny change but needs CI and dashboard wiring.
Eli G.: I'll open a PR to add confidences + a metric "judge_confidence_mean" and "judge_agreement_kappa" to the per-eval payload. also add per-quantization-mode logging (fp16/q8/q4).
Maria K.: pseudocode for fallback logic i sketched:
```
if unanimous:
  return majority
else:
  weights = softmax(confidences / temp)
  choice = argmax(sum(weights * votes))
  if tie or max_weight_diff < threshold:
    run_socratic_followup(example, options)
```
We should record the followup text + judge responses for auditing.
Ash S.: audit note: store followup text + hashed user metadata and demographic bucket (coarse) for bias analysis. do not store raw user identifiers.
Shiv P.: runner bug to watch: when fallback to fp16 happened earlier it also zeroed out per-token confidences in some batches. need unit test that runs judges in q8/q4/fp16 and checks sign agreement (win/lose) and confidence monotonicity.
Eli G.: will add bootstrap agreement test to CI: run N seeds, compute bootstrap CI for kappa and for weighted vote agreement. fail CI if kappa drops > 0.1 vs baseline.
EvalRunnerBot: created issue #1342: "socratic-followup-path + include_confidence in runner". Link: https://git.redwood/issue/1342 :thumbsup:
Maria K.: we also need to craft the socratic prompt carefully. example prompt: 
```
You are a judge evaluating two completions (A, B) for a user prompt. If you can pick a winner, respond with A or B and a confidence score. If you are uncertain, ask exactly one clarifying question that would help you decide.
```
Ash S.: add a calibration step: for each judge model, run a small anchored eval set that has known preferred answers (anchor examples) and compute bias vectors across demographic buckets. report per-judge calibration offsets.
Shiv P.: timeline: I'll draft RFC for the socratic tiebreak + CI tests. propose a 3-day nightly pilot on a small slice (5k examples) across quant modes.
Eli G.: ping me when the pilot lands; I'll hook the dashboard widgets and add a fail-open alert if the socratic path triggers > 5% of time and shows per-group skew.
Maria K.: thanks — if we can get confidences in the runner this week we can iterate fast.
Shiv P.: starting branch now. tagging @Eli G. and @Ash S. for review.
EvalRunnerBot: nightly job enqueued for pilot run at 1765510000.
Maria K.: awesome — also add a small human-in-the-loop check for the first 200 followups to ensure the clarifying questions are neutral and not leading.
Shiv P.: yup. I'll include a small HIT export.
Eli G.: cool. closing loop once dashboards show results.
